name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Hormuz largely shut; US blockade; strikes paused
summary: US keeps its naval blockade while pausing strikes; Rubio says economic means suffice (10 Nov); Hormuz still largely shut
state: Secretary of State Rubio said on 10 Nov there was no need for major US combat operations against Iran because the same objective was being met by economic means, after President Trump said on 9 Nov the war was militarily effectively over (CBS News). The naval blockade continues (StratNews Global). Iran has said Hormuz reopens only once seven conditions are met, after the US approved a Qatari draft on 3 Nov (Express Tribune). The largely closed strait sets the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states, which is changing at short notice.
rubric_hit: Strait of Hormuz substantially closed = Alert

sources.title: CBS News — Live updates: Rubio says US has no need to restart combat operations in Iran
StratNews Global — Trump says no new military strikes on Iran, Hormuz blockade continues

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
